text.21:112: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
text.22:40: Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty -
text.22:49: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.
text.22:68: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do.
text.22:72: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!
text.23:23: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.23:24: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
text.23:26: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text.23:28: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
text.23:29: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
text.23:33: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
text.23:39: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text.23:40: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
text.23:47: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
text.23:70: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
text.23:81: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
text.23:82: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
text.23:84: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
text.23:85: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
text.23:86: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
text.23:87: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
text.23:88: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
text.23:89: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
text.23:93: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
text.23:97: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
text.23:99: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
text.23:106: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
text.23:108: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
text.23:109: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
text.23:112: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
text.23:113: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
text.23:114: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
text.23:118: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
text.24:12: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?
text.24:15: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.
text.24:16: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.
text.24:26: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.
text.24:28: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do.
text.24:30: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.
text.24:31: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed.
text.24:47: And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers.
text.24:51: The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful.
text.24:53: They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.
text.24:54: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly.
text.25:4: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.
text.25:5: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.
text.25:6: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.25:7: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him.
text.25:8: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.
text.25:15: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.
text.25:17: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?
text.25:18: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.
text.25:19: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.
text.25:21: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.
text.25:22: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
text.25:27: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!
text.25:30: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.
text.25:32: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.
text.25:36: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
text.25:57: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.
text.25:60: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.
text.25:63: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
text.25:65: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
text.25:74: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
text.25:77: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
text.26:12: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
text.26:15: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
text.26:16: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
text.26:18: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
text.26:20: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
text.26:23: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
text.26:24: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
text.26:25: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
text.26:26: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
text.26:27: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
text.26:28: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
text.26:29: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
text.26:30: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
text.26:31: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
text.26:34: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
text.26:36: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
text.26:39: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
text.26:41: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
text.26:42: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).
text.26:43: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!
text.26:44: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.
text.26:47: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
text.26:49: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
text.26:50: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
text.26:61: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
text.26:62: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
text.26:70: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
text.26:71: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
text.26:72: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
text.26:74: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
text.26:75: He said: See now that which ye worship,
text.26:92: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
text.26:96: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
text.26:106: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.26:111: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
text.26:112: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
text.26:116: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
text.26:117: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
text.26:124: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.26:136: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
text.26:142: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.26:153: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
text.26:155: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
text.26:161: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.26:167: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
text.26:168: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
text.26:177: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.26:185: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
text.26:188: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
text.26:203: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
text.26:216: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
text.26:226: And how they say that which they do not?
text.27:7: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
text.27:13: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
text.27:15: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!
text.27:16: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.
text.27:18: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.
text.27:19: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.
text.27:20: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?
text.27:22: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.
text.27:27: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.
text.27:29: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.
text.27:32: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me.
text.27:33: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command.
text.27:34: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.
text.27:36: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.
text.27:38: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?
text.27:39: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work.
text.27:40: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.
text.27:41: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided.
text.27:42: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah).
text.27:44: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
text.27:46: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.
text.27:47: They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested.
text.27:49: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.
text.27:54: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?
text.27:56: But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!
text.27:59: Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?
text.27:64: Is not He (best) Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you from the heaven and the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful!
text.27:65: Say (O Muhammad): None in the heavens and the earth knoweth the Unseen save Allah; and they know not when they will be raised (again).
text.27:67: Yet those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust like our fathers, shall we verily be brought forth (again)?
text.27:69: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!
text.27:71: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
text.27:72: Say: It may be that a part of that which ye would hasten on is close behind you.
text.27:84: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?
text.27:92: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.
text.27:93: And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.
text.28:9: And the wife of Pharaoh said: (He will be) a consolation for me and for thee. Kill him not. Peradventure he may be of use to us, or we may choose him for a son. And they perceived not.
text.28:11: And she said unto his sister: Trace him. So she observed him from afar, and they perceived not.
text.28:12: And We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him, so she said: Shall I show you a household who will rear him for you and take care of him?
text.28:15: And he entered the city at a time of carelessness of its folk, and he found therein two men fighting, one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies; and he who was of his caste asked him for help against him who was of his enemies. So Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: This is of the devil's doing. Lo! he is an enemy, a mere misleader.
text.28:16: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged my soul, so forgive me. Then He forgave him. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
text.28:17: He said: My Lord! Forasmuch as Thou hast favoured me, I will nevermore be a supporter of the guilty.
text.28:18: And morning found him in the city, fearing, vigilant, when behold! he who had appealed to him the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said unto him: Lo! thou art indeed a mere hothead.
text.28:19: And when he would have fallen upon the man who was an enemy unto them both, he said: O Moses! Wouldst thou kill me as thou didst kill a person yesterday. Thou wouldst be nothing but a tyrant in the land, thou wouldst not be of the reformers.
text.28:20: And a man came from the uttermost part of the city, running. He said: O Moses! Lo! the chiefs take counsel against thee to slay thee; therefor escape. Lo! I am of those who give thee good advice.
text.28:21: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.
text.28:22: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said: Peradventure my Lord will guide me in the right road.
text.28:23: And when he came unto the water of Midian he found there a whole tribe of men, watering. And he found apart from them two women keeping back (their flocks). He said: What aileth you? The two said: We cannot give (our flocks) to drink till the shepherds return from the water; and our father is a very old man.
text.28:24: So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.
text.28:25: Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: Lo! my father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us. Then, when he came unto him and told him the (whole) story, he said: Fear not! Thou hast escaped from the wrongdoing folk.
text.28:26: One of the two women said: O my father! Hire him! For the best (man) that thou canst hire in the strong, the trustworthy.
text.28:27: He said: Lo! I fain would marry thee to one of these two daughters of mine on condition that thou hirest thyself to me for (the term of) eight pilgrimages. Then if thou completest ten it will be of thine own accord, for I would not make it hard for thee. Allah willing, thou wilt find me of the righteous.
text.28:28: He said: That (is settled) between thee and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allah is Surety over what we say.
text.28:29: Then, when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his housefolk, he saw in the distance a fire and said unto his housefolk: Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire; peradventure I shall bring you tidings thence, or a brand from the fire that ye may warm yourselves.
text.28:33: He said: My Lord! Lo! I killed a man among them and I fear that they will kill me.
text.28:35: He said: We will strengthen thine arm with thy brother, and We will give unto you both power so that they cannot reach you for Our portents. Ye twain, and those who follow you, will be the winners.
text.28:36: But when Moses came unto them with Our clear tokens, they said: This is naught but invented magic. We never heard of this among our fathers of old.
text.28:37: And Moses said: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance from His presence, and whose will be the sequel of the Home (of bliss). Lo! wrong-doers will not be successful.
text.28:38: And Pharaoh said: O chiefs! I know not that ye have a god other than me, so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses; and lo! I deem him of the liars.
text.28:47: Otherwise, if disaster should afflict them because of that which their own hands have sent before (them), they might say: Our Lord! Why sentest Thou no messenger unto us, that we might have followed Thy revelations and been of the believers?
text.28:48: But when there came unto them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Why is he not given the like of what was given unto Moses? Did they not disbelieve in that which was given unto Moses of old? They say: Two magics that support each other; and they say: Lo! in both we are disbelievers.
text.28:49: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Then bring a scripture from the presence of Allah that giveth clearer guidance than these two (that) I may follow it, if ye are truthful.
text.28:53: And when it is recited unto them, they say: We believe in it. Lo! it is the Truth from our Lord. Lo! even before it we were of those who surrender (unto Him).
text.28:55: And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.
text.28:57: And they say: If we were to follow the Guidance with thee we should be torn out of our land. Have We not established for them a sure sanctuary, whereunto the produce of all things is brought (in trade), a provision from Our presence? But most of them know not.
text.28:62: On the day when He will call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye imagined?
text.28:63: Those concerning whom the Word will have come true will say: Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray even as we ourselves were astray. We declare our innocence before Thee: us they never worshipped.
text.28:64: And it will be said: Cry unto your (so-called) partners (of Allah). And they will cry unto them, and they will give no answer unto them, and they will see the Doom. Ah, if they had but been guided!
text.28:65: And on the Day when He will call unto them and say: What answer gave ye to the messengers?
text.28:71: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made night everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you light? Will ye not then hear?
text.28:72: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made day everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you night wherein ye rest? Will ye not then see?
text.28:74: And on the Day when He shall call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye pretended?
text.28:75: And We shall take out from every nation a witness and We shall say: Bring your proof. Then they will know that Allah hath the Truth, and all that they invented will have failed them.
text.28:76: Now Korah was of Moses' folk, but he oppressed them; and We gave him so much treasure that the stores thereof would verily have been a burden for a troop of mighty men. When his own folk said unto him: Exult not; lo! Allah loveth not the exultant;
text.28:78: He said: I have been given it only on account of knowledge I possess. Knew he not that Allah had destroyed already of the generations before him men who were mightier than him in strength and greater in respect of following? The guilty are not questioned of their sins.
text.28:79: Then went he forth before his people in his pomp. Those who were desirous of the life of the world said: Ah, would that we had the like of what hath been given unto Korah! Lo! he is lord of rare good fortune.
text.28:80: But those who had been given knowledge said: Woe unto you! The reward of Allah for him who believeth and doeth right is better, and only the steadfast will obtain it.
text.28:82: And morning found those who had coveted his place but yesterday crying: Ah, welladay! Allah enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His slaves and straiteneth it (for whom He will). If Allah had not been gracious unto us He would have caused it to swallow us (also). Ah, welladay! the disbelievers never prosper.
text.28:85: Lo! He Who hath given thee the Qur'an for a law will surely bring thee home again. Say: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance and him who is in error manifest.
text.29:2: Do men imagine that they will be left (at ease) because they say, We believe, and will not be tested with affliction?
text.29:10: Of mankind is he who saith: We believe in Allah, but, if he be made to suffer for the sake of Allah, he mistaketh the persecution of mankind for Allah's punishment; and then, if victory cometh from thy Lord, will say: Lo! we were with you (all the while). Is not Allah Best Aware of what is in the bosoms of (His) creatures?
text.29:12: Those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Follow our way (of religion) and we verily will bear your sins (for you). They cannot bear aught of their sins. Lo! they verily are liars.
text.29:16: And Abraham! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Serve Allah, and keep your duty unto Him; that is better for you if ye did but know.
text.29:20: Say (O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see how He originated creation, then Allah bringeth forth the later growth. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.
text.29:24: But the answer of his folk was only that they said: "Kill him" or "Burn him." Then Allah saved him from the Fire. Lo! herein verily are portents for folk who believe.
text.29:25: He said: Ye have chosen only idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection ye will deny each other and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and ye will have no helpers.
text.29:26: And Lot believed him, and said: Lo! I am a fugitive unto my Lord. Lo! He, only He, is the Mighty, the Wise.
text.29:28: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Lo! ye commit lewdness such as no creature did before you.
text.29:29: For come ye not in unto males, and cut ye not the road (for travellers), and commit ye not abomination in your meetings? But the answer of his folk was only that they said: Bring Allah's doom upon us if thou art a truthteller!
text.29:30: He said: My Lord! Give me victory over folk who work corruption.
text.29:31: And when Our messengers brought Abraham the good news, they said: Lo! we are about to destroy the people of that township, for its people are wrong-doers.
text.29:32: He said: Lo! Lot is there. They said: We are best aware of who is there. We are to deliver him and his household, all save his wife, who is of those who stay behind.
text.29:33: And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was troubled upon their account, for he could not protect them; but they said: Fear not, nor grieve! Lo! we are to deliver thee and thy household, (all) save thy wife, who is of those who stay behind.
text.29:36: And unto Midian We sent Shu'eyb, their brother. He said: O my people! Serve Allah, and look forward to the Last Day, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
text.29:46: And argue not with the People of the Scripture unless it be in (a way) that is better, save with such of them as do wrong; and say: We believe in that which hath been revealed unto us and revealed unto you; our Allah and your Allah is One, and unto Him we surrender.
text.29:50: And they say: Why are not portents sent down upon him from his Lord? Say: Portents are with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner.
text.29:52: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah sufficeth for witness between me and you. He knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who believe in vanity and disbelieve in Allah, they it is who are the losers.
text.29:55: On the day when the doom will overwhelm them from above them and from underneath their feet, and He will say: Taste what ye used to do!
text.29:61: And if thou wert to ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, and constrained the sun and the moon (to their appointed work)? they would say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
text.29:63: And if thou wert to ask them: Who causeth water to come down from the sky, and therewith reviveth the earth after its death? they verily would say: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them have no sense.
text.30:42: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for those who were before you! Most of them were idolaters.
text.30:56: But those to whom knowledge and faith are given will say: The truth is, ye have tarried, by Allah's decree, until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but ye used not to know.
text.30:58: Verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes; and indeed if thou camest unto them with a miracle, those who disbelieve would verily exclaim: Ye are but tricksters!
text.31:13: And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him: O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -
text.31:21: And if it be said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: Nay, but we follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though the devil were inviting them unto the doom of flame?
text.31:25: If thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they would answer: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.
text.32:3: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but it is the Truth from thy Lord, that thou mayst warn a folk to whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may walk aright.
text.32:10: And they say: When we are lost in the earth, how can we then be re-created? Nay but they are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.
text.32:11: Say: The angel of death, who hath charge concerning you, will gather you, and afterward unto your Lord ye will be returned.
text.32:20: And as for those who do evil, their retreat is the Fire. Whenever they desire to issue forth from thence, they are brought back thither. Unto them it is said: Taste the torment of the Fire which ye used to deny.
text.32:28: And they say: When cometh this victory (of yours) if ye are truthful?
text.32:29: Say (unto them): On the day of the victory the faith of those who disbelieve (and who then will believe) will not avail them, neither will they be reprieved.
text.33:4: Allah hath not assigned unto any man two hearts within his body, nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers) your mothers, nor hath He made those whom ye claim (to be your sons) your sons. This is but a saying of your mouths. But Allah saith the truth and He showeth the way.
text.33:12: And when the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, were saying: Allah and His messenger promised us naught but delusion.
text.33:13: And when a party of them said: O folk of Yathrib! There is no stand (possible) for you, therefor turn back. And certain of them (even) sought permission of the Prophet, saying: Our homes lie open (to the enemy). And they lay not open. They but wished to flee.
text.33:16: Say: Flight will not avail you if ye flee from death or killing, and then ye dwell in comfort but a little while.
text.33:17: Say: Who is he who can preserve you from Allah if He intendeth harm for you, or intendeth mercy for you. They will not find that they have any friend or helper other than Allah.
text.33:22: And when the true believers saw the clans, they said: This is that which Allah and His messenger promised us. Allah and His messenger are true. It did but confirm them in their faith and resignation.
text.33:28: O Prophet! Say unto thy wives: If ye desire the world's life and its adornment, come! I will content you and will release you with a fair release.
text.33:32: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.
text.33:37: And when thou saidst unto him on whom Allah hath conferred favour and thou hast conferred favour: Keep thy wife to thyself, and fear Allah. And thou didst hide in thy mind that which Allah was to bring to light, and thou didst fear mankind whereas Allah hath a better right that thou shouldst fear Him. So when Zeyd had performed that necessary formality (of divorce) from her, We gave her unto thee in marriage, so that (henceforth) there may be no sin for believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have performed the necessary formality (of release) from them. The commandment of Allah must be fulfilled.
text.33:59: O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers to draw their cloaks close round them (when they go abroad). That will be better, so that they may be recognised and not annoyed. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
text.33:63: Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh.
text.33:66: On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!
text.33:67: And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way.
text.33:69: O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight.
text.33:70: O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point;
text.34:3: Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record,
text.34:7: Those who disbelieve say: Shall we show you a man who will tell you (that) when ye have become dispersed in dust with most complete dispersal still, even then, ye will be created anew?
text.34:19: But they said: Our Lord! Make the stage between our journeys longer. And they wronged themselves, therefore We made them bywords (in the land) and scattered them abroad, a total scattering. Lo! herein verily are portents for each steadfast, grateful (heart).
text.34:22: Say (O Muhammad): Call upon those whom ye set up beside Allah! They possess not an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor hath He an auxiliary among them.
text.34:23: No intercession availeth with Him save for him whom He permitteth. Yet, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What was it that your Lord said? They say: The Truth. And He is the Sublime, the Great.
text.34:24: Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest.
text.34:25: Say: Ye will not be asked of what we committed, nor shall we be asked of what ye do.
text.34:26: Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge.
text.34:27: Say: Show me those whom ye have joined unto Him as partners. Nay (ye dare not)! For He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
text.34:29: And they say: When is this promise (to be fulfilled) if ye are truthful?
text.34:30: Say (O Muhammad): Yours is the promise of a Day which ye cannot postpone nor hasten by an hour.
text.34:31: And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers.
text.34:32: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.
text.34:33: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?
text.34:34: And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.
text.34:35: And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished!
text.34:36: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not.
text.34:39: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.
text.34:40: And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you?
text.34:41: They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them.
text.34:42: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.
text.34:43: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.
text.34:46: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom.
text.34:47: Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things.
text.34:48: Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden.
text.34:49: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.
text.34:50: Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh.
text.34:52: And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off,
text.35:34: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,
text.35:40: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.
text.36:14: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
text.36:15: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
text.36:16: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
text.36:18: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
text.36:19: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
text.36:20: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
text.36:26: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
text.36:45: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
text.36:47: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
text.36:48: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
text.36:52: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
text.36:78: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
text.36:79: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
text.36:82: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
text.37:15: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
text.37:18: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
text.37:20: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
text.37:28: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
text.37:29: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
text.37:35: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
text.37:36: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
text.37:51: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
text.37:52: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
text.37:56: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
text.37:85: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
text.37:89: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
text.37:91: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
text.37:95: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
text.37:97: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
text.37:99: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
text.37:102: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
text.37:124: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
text.37:151: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
text.37:167: And indeed they used to say:
text.38:4: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
text.38:16: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
text.38:17: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
text.38:22: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
text.38:23: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
text.38:24: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
text.38:32: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
text.38:35: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
text.38:60: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
text.38:61: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!
text.38:62: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
text.38:65: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
text.38:71: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,
text.38:75: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?
text.38:76: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.
text.38:77: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,
text.38:79: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
text.38:80: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
text.38:82: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
text.38:84: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,
text.38:86: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
text.39:8: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.
text.39:9: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.
text.39:10: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.
text.39:11: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
text.39:13: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day.
text.39:14: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only).
text.39:15: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!
text.39:24: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn.
text.39:38: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust.
text.39:39: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know
text.39:43: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence?
text.39:44: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back.
text.39:46: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ.
text.39:49: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not.
text.39:50: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not;
text.39:53: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
text.39:56: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers!
text.39:57: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful!
text.39:58: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous!
text.39:64: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools!
text.39:71: And those who disbelieve are driven unto hell in troops till, when they reach it and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Came there not unto you messengers of your own, reciting unto you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? they say: Yea, verily. But the word of doom of disbelievers is fulfilled.
text.39:72: It is said (unto them): Enter ye the gates of hell to dwell therein. Thus hapless is the journey's end of the scorners.
text.39:73: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;
text.39:74: They say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath fulfilled His promise unto us and hath made us inherit the land, sojourning in the Garden where we will! So bounteous is the wage of workers.
text.39:75: And thou (O Muhammad) seest the angels thronging round the Throne, hymning the praises of their Lord. And they are judged aright. And it is said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
text.40:11: They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out?
text.40:24: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer!
text.40:25: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error.
text.40:26: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land.
text.40:27: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning.
text.40:28: And a believing man of Pharaoh's family, who hid his faith, said: Would ye kill a man because he saith: My Lord is Allah, and hath brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is lying, then his lie is upon him; and if he is truthful, then some of that wherewith he threateneth you will strike you. Lo! Allah guideth not one who is a prodigal, a liar.
text.40:29: O my people! Yours is the kingdom to-day, ye being uppermost in the land. But who would save us from the wrath of Allah should it reach us? Pharaoh said: I do but show you what I think, and I do but guide you to wise policy.
text.40:30: And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old);
text.40:34: And verily Joseph brought you of old clear proofs, yet ye ceased not to be in doubt concerning what he brought you till, when he died, ye said: Allah will not send any messenger after him. Thus Allah deceiveth him who is a prodigal, a doubter.
text.40:36: And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads,
text.40:38: And he who believed said: O my people! Follow me. I will show you the way of right conduct.
text.40:44: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.
text.40:47: And when they wrangle in the Fire, the weak say unto those who were proud: Lo! we were a following unto you; will ye therefor rid us of a portion of the Fire?
text.40:48: Those who were proud say: Lo! we are all (together) herein. Lo! Allah hath judged between (His) slaves.
text.40:49: And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment.
text.40:50: They say: Came not your messengers unto you with clear proofs? They say: Yea, verily. They say: Then do ye pray, although the prayer of disbelievers is in vain.
text.40:60: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.
text.40:66: Say (O Muhammad): I am forbidden to worship those unto whom ye cry beside Allah since there have come unto me clear proofs from my Lord, and I am commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Worlds.
text.40:68: He it is Who quickeneth and giveth death. When He ordaineth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
text.40:73: Then it is said unto them: Where are (all) that ye used to make partners (in the Sovereignty)
text.40:74: Beside Allah? They say: They have failed us; but we used not to pray to anything before. Thus doth Allah send astray the disbelievers (in His guidance).
text.40:84: Then, when they saw Our doom, they said: We believe in Allah only and reject (all) that we used to associate (with Him).
text.41:5: And they say: Our hearts are protected from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act, then. Lo! we also shall be acting.
text.41:6: Say (unto them O Muhammad): I am only a mortal like you. It is inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah, therefor take the straight path unto Him and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe unto the idolaters,
text.41:9: Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.
text.41:11: Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.
text.41:13: But if they turn away, then say: I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud;
text.41:14: When their messengers came unto them from before them and behind them, saying: Worship none but Allah! they said: If our Lord had willed, He surely would have sent down angels (unto us), so lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.
text.41:15: As for A'ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: Who is mightier than us in power? Could they not see that Allah Who created them, He was mightier than them in power? And they denied Our revelations.
text.41:21: And they say unto their skins: Why testify ye against us? They say: Allah hath given us speech Who giveth speech to all things, and Who created you at the first, and unto Whom ye are returned.
text.41:26: Those who disbelieve say: Heed not this Qur'an, and drown the hearing of it; haply ye may conquer.
text.41:29: And those who disbelieve will say: Our Lord! Show us those who beguiled us of the jinn and humankind. We will place them underneath our feet that they may be among the nethermost.
text.41:30: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and afterward are upright, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not nor grieve, but hear good tidings of the paradise which ye are promised.
text.41:33: And who is better in speech than him who prayeth unto his Lord and doeth right, and saith: Lo! I am of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).
text.41:43: Naught is said unto thee (Muhammad) save what was said unto the messengers before thee. Lo! thy Lord is owner of forgiveness, and owner (also) of dire punishment.
text.41:44: And if We had appointed it a Lecture in a foreign tongue they would assuredly have said: If only its verses were expounded (so that we might understand)? What! A foreign tongue and an Arab? - Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance and a healing; and as for those who disbelieve, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. Such are called to from afar.
text.41:47: Unto Him is referred (all) knowledge of the Hour. And no fruits burst forth from their sheaths, and no female carrieth or bringeth forth but with His knowledge. And on the day when He calleth unto them: Where are now My partners? they will say: We confess unto Thee, not one of us is a witness (for them).
text.41:50: And verily, if We cause him to taste mercy after some hurt that hath touched him, he will say: This is my own; and I deem not that the Hour will ever rise, and if I am brought back to my Lord, I surely shall be better off with Him - But We verily shall tell those who disbelieve (all) that they did, and We verily shall make them taste hard punishment.
text.41:52: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)?
text.42:15: Unto this, then, summon (O Muhammad). And be thou upright as thou art commanded, and follow not their lusts, but say: I believe in whatever scripture Allah hath sent down, and I am commanded to be just among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Unto us our works and unto you your works; no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and unto Him is the journeying.
text.42:23: This it is which Allah announceth unto His bondmen who believe and do good works. Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee therefor, save lovingkindness among kinsfolk. And whoso scoreth a good deed We add unto its good for him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Responsive.
text.42:24: Or say they: He hath invented a lie concerning Allah? If Allah willed, He could have sealed thy heart (against them). And Allah will wipe out the lie and will vindicate the truth by His words. Lo! He is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).
text.42:44: He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return?
text.42:45: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment?
text.43:9: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
text.43:13: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);
text.43:20: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.
text.43:22: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.
text.43:23: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.
text.43:24: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
text.43:26: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
text.43:30: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
text.43:31: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
text.43:38: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
text.43:46: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
text.43:49: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
text.43:51: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
text.43:58: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
text.43:63: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
text.43:77: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
text.43:81: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
text.43:87: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
text.43:89: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
text.44:14: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
text.45:14: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
text.45:24: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
text.45:25: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.
text.45:26: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
text.45:32: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.
text.45:34: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
text.46:4: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
text.46:7: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.
text.46:8: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
text.46:9: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
text.46:10: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.
text.46:11: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;
text.46:13: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
text.46:15: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
text.46:17: And whoso saith unto his parents: Fie upon you both! Do ye threaten me that I shall be brought forth (again) when generations before me have passed away? And they twain cry unto Allah for help (and say): Woe unto thee! Believe! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. But he saith: This is naught save fables of the men of old:
text.46:22: They said: Hast come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.
text.46:23: He said: The knowledge is with Allah only. I convey unto you that wherewith I have been sent, but I see you are a folk that know not.
text.46:24: Then, when they beheld it as a dense cloud coming toward their valleys, they said: Here is a cloud bringing us rain. Nay, but it is that which ye did seek to hasten, a wind wherein is painful torment,
text.46:29: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.
text.46:30: They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road.
text.46:34: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved.
text.47:16: Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts.
text.47:20: And those who believe say: If only a surah were revealed! But when a decisive surah is revealed and war is mentioned therein, thou seest those in whose hearts is a disease looking at thee with the look of men fainting unto death. Therefor woe unto them!
text.47:26: That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk.
text.48:11: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.
text.48:15: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little.
text.48:16: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.
text.49:14: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.49:16: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?
text.49:17: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.
text.50:2: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
text.50:23: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
text.50:27: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
text.50:28: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
text.50:30: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
text.50:39: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
text.50:45: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
text.51:25: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
text.51:27: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
text.51:28: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
text.51:29: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
text.51:30: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
text.51:31: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
text.51:32: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
text.51:39: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
text.51:43: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
text.51:52: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
text.52:26: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
text.52:30: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
text.52:31: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
text.52:33: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
text.52:44: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
text.54:2: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
text.54:8: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
text.54:9: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
text.54:24: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
text.54:44: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
text.56:47: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
text.56:49: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
text.57:13: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
text.57:14: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;
text.58:2: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.58:3: Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and Allah is Informed of what ye do.
text.58:8: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end!
text.58:11: O ye who believe! when it is said unto you, Make room! in assemblies, then make room; Allah will make way for you (hereafter). And when it is said, Come up higher! go up higher; Allah will exalt those who believe among you, and those who have knowledge, to high ranks. Allah is Informed of what ye do.
text.59:10: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.
text.59:11: Hast thou not observed those who are hypocrites, (how) they tell their brethren who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture: If ye are driven out, we surely will go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if ye are attacked we verily will help you. And Allah beareth witness that they verily are liars.
text.59:16: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
text.60:4: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.
text.61:2: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not?
text.61:3: It is most hateful in the sight of Allah that ye say that which ye do not.
text.61:5: And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Why persecute ye me, when ye well know that I am Allah's messenger unto you? So when they went astray Allah sent their hearts astray. And Allah guideth not the evil-living folk.
text.61:6: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic.
text.61:14: O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah? They said: We are Allah's helpers.
