And a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost.
text.62:6: Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful.
text.62:8: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! the death from which ye shrink will surely meet you, and afterward ye will be returned unto the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will tell you what ye used to do.
text.62:11: But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers.
text.63:1: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely.
text.63:4: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!
text.63:5: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful.
text.63:7: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not.
text.63:8: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not.
text.63:10: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.
text.64:6: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.
text.64:7: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah.
text.66:3: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me.
text.66:8: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
text.66:10: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter.
text.66:11: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;
text.67:9: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.
text.67:10: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.
text.67:23: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
text.67:24: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.
text.67:25: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
text.67:26: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;
text.67:27: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.
text.67:28: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?
text.67:29: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.
text.67:30: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?
text.68:15: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
text.68:26: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
text.68:28: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
text.68:29: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
text.68:31: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
text.68:51: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
text.69:19: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
text.69:25: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
text.71:2: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
text.71:5: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
text.71:10: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
text.71:21: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
text.71:23: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
text.71:26: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
text.72:1: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
text.72:4: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
text.72:5: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
text.72:20: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
text.72:21: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
text.72:22: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
text.72:25: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
text.73:10: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
text.74:24: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
text.74:31: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
text.74:43: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
text.75:10: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
text.75:27: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
text.77:48: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
text.78:38: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
text.78:40: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
text.79:10: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
text.79:12: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
text.79:18: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
text.79:24: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
text.83:13: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
text.83:17: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
text.83:32: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
text.89:15: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
text.89:16: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
text.89:24: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
text.90:6: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
text.91:13: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
text.99:3: And man saith: What aileth her?
text.112:1: Say: He is Allah, the One!
